cases.snapshot_text: OpenAI introduced the Agents API on September 10, 2026 in public beta, describing a managed Codex harness for long-running agents.
cases.claim: Agents API is available in public beta.

cases.snapshot_text: OpenAI launched GPT-Live-1 in the API and states that it can listen and speak at the same time.
cases.claim: GPT-Live-1 is available in the API with full-duplex listening and speaking.

cases.snapshot_text: Google announced Android transfer of passwords and passkeys between password managers without file downloads, with user review and authorization.
cases.claim: Android supports direct transfer of passwords and passkeys between supported password managers.

cases.snapshot_text: Google announced the Gemini app for Windows on September 10, 2026, including Alt+Space desktop access.
cases.claim: The Gemini app is available for Windows.

cases.snapshot_text: Adobe's Q3 FY2026 earnings release states that Adobe achieved more than one billion monthly active users across creativity and productivity solutions.
cases.claim: Adobe reported more than 1 billion monthly active users.

cases.snapshot_text: OpenAI states that new sign-ups and upgrades to Pro $200 (Pro 20X) are temporarily paused as of September 10, 2026, while Pro $100 remains available and existing Pro $200 subscriptions are not affected.
cases.claim: The pause applies to new Pro $200 sign-ups and upgrades, not all Pro subscriptions.

cases.snapshot_text: Google's system services release notes list September 2026 Android WebView updates and describe these notes as updates to Android, Play Store and Play services.
cases.claim: Google maintains first-party release notes for system-service changes.

cases.snapshot_text: Lucid states that its MCP server lets authorized AI tools search, retrieve, edit, summarize, and create Lucid documents, with admin controls for some plans.
cases.claim: Lucid provides an MCP server with document search and edit capabilities.

cases.snapshot_text: Epicor states that Grow BI replicates BisTrack data into a dedicated analytics environment and runs analytics on replicated data rather than the live BisTrack database.
cases.claim: Grow BI can isolate analytics from the live operational database using replicated data.

cases.snapshot_text: StackAI advertises feature controls, audit logs, human-in-the-loop approval points, and 100+ enterprise integrations.
cases.claim: StackAI advertises governance controls and 100+ integrations.

cases.snapshot_text: A 9to5Google card reports that Googlebook pre-orders start September 21, while the Google first-party announcement establishes the product but not this preorder date in the source set.
cases.claim: September 21 preorder date is secondary-reported pending a first-party preorder record.
